parole.significato: Any shrubland biota in Mediterranean countries, typically consisting of densely-growing evergreen shrubs.
parole.testo: From Corsican machja, related to Italian macchia and French maquis; ultimately from Latin macula. Doublet of macula, macule, and maquis.
